Small Company Audit Exemption Criteria

A company qualifies as a small company if it is a private company throughout the financial year and satisfies at least 2 of the following 3 criteria for each of the immediate past two consecutive financial years:

(a) total annual revenue does not exceed $10 million; (b) total assets does not exceed $10 million; (c) number of full-time employees does not exceed 50.
